name: Mi Material Holding Limited
summary: Mi Material Holding Limited, through its subsidiaries, manufactures precision solder spheres and related semiconductor advanced packaging materials under the accurus brand. The company produces solder spheres that serve as interconnect components for electrical connectivity between integrated circuits and printed circuit boards in advanced semiconductor packaging applications. It produces proprietary solder sphere products, such as iSAC, an alloy engineered for mobile and portable computing applications; Cyclomax, a solder sphere alloy for automotive and other applications; and Ecolloy, a solder sphere line for sustainable semiconductor packaging.
